description: A stylesheet on the same port under another hostname (localhost) answers 404: critical silently drops it.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. {{alias}} is localhost:18981 and the page is on 127.0.0.1:18981: the same port under another HOSTNAME, so it is another host under a hostname comparison as well as under host:port. A comparison on the port alone would call it the same host and fail the job.
